name: ErgoMax High Back Breathable Mesh Ergonomic Office Chair

description.mood_line: Sustain peak focus through extended study sessions with adaptive support that aligns your posture naturally.
description.intro: The ErgoMax High Back Breathable Mesh Ergonomic Office Chair features a tall, supportive silhouette engineered for all-day domestic utility.
description.story: Crafted from jet black nylon mesh and high-density cushioning, this chair offers superior breathability and pressure dispersion across its 65 cm wide seat. A chrome-plated five-star base ensures stability, while the pneumatic Class 4 gas lift allows precise height adjustment between 1.15 and 1.25 meters. The 2D adjustable lumbar support and 3D armrests fine-tune alignment to match your unique study posture.
description.close: Ground your study space in ergonomic precision, ensuring every hour of work feels as effortless as the first.

name: Stride Mid Back Revolving Computer Chair with Padded Armrests

description.mood_line: Elevate every study session with a chair that moves as you do.
description.intro: Stride, the mid‑back revolving study chair, blends sleek cobalt blue with a precision‑crafted silhouette.
description.story: Its seat is a lattice of high‑density molded foam, wrapped in breathable fabric that keeps you cool during long hours. The frame, finished in a subtle matte cobalt, sits on a heavy‑duty nylon base with dual‑wheel castors that glide effortlessly across any surface. With a 60‑cm square footprint and a height range of 95‑105 cm, it fits comfortably into study rooms of all sizes.
description.close: Stride turns your study space into a sanctuary of motion and comfort.
